title: Meeting minutes made available in a timely manner
source: M.G.L. c. 30A, § 22(a) — minutes shall be created and approved in a timely manner. The statute does not fix a number of days; the lag encoded here is an operator-configurable default.
scope_note: The 30 days is an operator default. The Open Meeting Law says "timely" without a number, so a green row is your own target met, not a legal finding.
